$Comment: The category every reputation's track sits in. Each reputation's standing is kept on a track of the same id, built from its ladder: its ranks are the track's tiers, and what it pays past the top is the track's Beyond. A reputation does not prestige unless the server owner turns it on for that reputation in mods/ziggfreedcommon/tracks.json, for example { "Hallows_Eve_Hallowed": { "Prestige": { "Ranks": 1 } } }; a prestige then starts its standing again while the best rank reached keeps everything it opened and how its people treat the player.
